Initial release — AI-powered founder coaching for the AI era.

- Structured system for daily decision journaling, accountability tracking, and weekly strategy reviews.
- Focused templates with AI-era strategic questions on moat, commoditization, and outcome-based pricing.
- Guided morning and evening check-ins for priority setting, reflection, and motivation tracking.
- Decision journal format to document important choices, reasoning, and outcomes.
- Automated storage and organization of all journal entries, reviews, and decisions in agent memory.
